reason: All 6 linux_riscv64 CI jobs fail identically with a solver error: no candidates found for cross-python_linux-riscv64. Every other platform (linux_64, aarch64, ppc64le, osx, win) passes, so this is riscv64-only and caused by a missing conda-forge package (cross-python not yet built for riscv64), not a bug in ujson's recipe.
